svg.title: Four pi pulses under a limit of two at a time
svg.desc: Two timelines of flip_four on the drive lines of 4 qudits. As late as possible, all 4 pi pulses play at once, from 0 ns. With the resource-constrained policy and at most 2 drives at once, 2 play from 0 ns and the others from 40 ns.

g.text: as late as possible: all four π pulses at once
schedule="rcp" with max_concurrent_drives=2: 2 at a time
